_meta.title: CLIP Text Encode (Negative Prompt)
_meta.note: Chinese negative prompt kept verbatim from the official Comfy-Org example (image_to_video_wan22_5B.json) — Wan 2.2 is a Chinese-origin model and this exact string is the maintainer-verified default, not a translation guess.

inputs.text: 色调艳丽，过曝，静态，细节模糊不清，字幕，风格，作品，画作，画面，静止，整体发灰，最差质量，低质量，JPEG压缩残留，丑陋的，残缺的，多余的手指，画得不好的手部，画得不好的脸部，畸形的，毁容的，形态畸形的肢体，手指融合，静止不动的画面，杂乱的背景，三条腿，背景人很多，倒着走

_meta.title: Wan22ImageToVideoLatent
_meta.note: 9:16 @ 720x1280, both multiples of 16 (Wan's VAE spatial stride). length={{frames}} — use 121 for ~5.04s at 24fps (4n+1 latent-stride length, same convention as the official example's length=41).

_meta.title: KSampler (non-distilled, 30-step)
_meta.note: No Lightning LoRA exists for TI2V-5B (only for the A14B MoE checkpoint — see workflows/README.md and models/download.sh) — this is the full 30-step path, steps/cfg/sampler/scheduler all taken verbatim from the official Comfy-Org example.

_meta.title: Create Video
_meta.note: Official example uses SaveWEBM (vp9/webm); swapped for the core CreateVideo+SaveVideo pair (same as workflows/i2v_ltx.json) to get mp4 directly instead of a separate ffmpeg transcode step.
